context._comment_feature_flags: Feature flags below change what CDK synthesizes. They are not part of deployments/<env>/env.yaml.
context._comment_checkSecretUsage: Fails synth if a Secrets Manager secret is used somewhere it would end up in plaintext.
context._comment_restrictDefaultSecurityGroup: Strips all rules from the VPC default security group (CIS 5.3, HIPAA). Adds Custom::VpcRestrictDefaultSG plus a Lambda and IAM role to every stack with a VPC. Set to false to drop them; CDK will not re-open the group.
